sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply a missing word in Acts 7:53 ('have not ___ it'), and no earlier card has told that verse or set up what the council did with the law. Kept, copied and read are all plausible, so the baker is guessing the wording of a line, not reasoning from what they've been told.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. / The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
